note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 crop is blobby and posterised; fur becomes watercolour blotches and the dark outlines and eyes look soft. usage null.
flags.fix: Lower label_up K (24 is too many clusters for this art) or add an edge-preserving pass so outlines and the eye highlights stay crisp.

flags.problem: Shapes and the Big Lug lettering are kept, but the green body has blotchy stamp-like mottling and the wrench edge softens at 1:1. usage null.
flags.fix: Reduce clustering on flat fills (fewer label clusters or a flat-fill mode) and re-sharpen the wrench and text outlines.

flags.problem: Grey body at 1:1 reads as a blocky mosaic with patchy colour; mean_shift is 3.46, the highest of the set. Logo is intact. usage null.
flags.fix: Drop label_up K from 48 to about 24-32 and check the grey and blue tone shift against the original.

flags.problem: 1:1 centre is smeared blue-grey with only a faint red grid, so it reads as soft plastic rather than a steel panel. Emblem silhouette is kept. Wall-side, 92% of use.
flags.fix: Lower the shade smoothing (shade=0.8 looks too strong) and restore crisp grid lines and panel edges; keep the rivet rows sharp.

flags.problem: Wheel and axle at 1:1 are mushy, with stamp-like blotches on the rim. The brown planks above show dark vertical seams. Cutout edge is slightly jagged.
flags.fix: Lower the label K (32 is too many clusters for the wheel), restore rim highlights and the axle line, and smooth the alpha edge.

flags.problem: no real detail gain over a smooth enlargement (0.94x)
flags.fix: make it pass the gate honestly, or mark(...) it if it cannot
